findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, Second Reading, Roll Call #758
findings.note: House Second Reading vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes. Passed 66 to 47. Lopez is listed among the Noes. The ratified bill requires an applicant at a drivers license office to affirmatively state US citizenship before the registration proceeds, requires a sworn citizenship statement on registration forms, and directs the State Board to set a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens by a federal database.

findings.motion: HB 958, Election Law Changes, M11 Concur, Roll Call #801
findings.note: House vote to concur in the Senate changes to HB 958, Election Law Changes. Passed 62 to 47. Lopez is listed among the Noes. The bill page lists a Governor's veto of HB 958 and a last action of placed on calendar for 09/02/2026.

findings.motion: Co-sponsor of HB 1246, Safeguarding Elections Act (filed 2026-07-30, referred to House Rules 2026-08-04)
findings.note: He is listed among the co-sponsors. The bill text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/HTML/H1246v1.html) adds a misdemeanor for demanding citizenship documentation from a voter beyond what state law requires, and also covers troops at polling places and voter intimidation. The co-sponsor list reads only 'Lopez'.
